summary: Iteration 10 tested the new height+weight+sex 'Calcola taglia' box, the tape calibration in /wardrobe, the MY ATELIER logo, the black public page and app header, the favicons and the regressions. Backend: 16/17 pytests passed (tests/test_quick_estimate.py). The one failure (index.html favicon links) came from the frontend dev server serving a stale index.html; after I restarted the frontend it serves the links. Covered: 422 on height 100/240, weight 30/160, gender unisex or missing; 401 without auth; method 'height_weight' with chest/waist/hips/shoulder/inseam and brand_sizes stored and shown by GET; kept_precise=true for a tape user with the same height and sex (circumferences untouched, weight updated); a height change re-estimates the values; logo.png, logo-white.png, favicon.ico/png and apple-touch-icon return 200. Frontend on the live URL: the dashboard box has only url/height/weight/male/female (no chest/waist/hips/shoulder testids or labels). All 6 validation toasts work (no URL, empty height, height 250, empty weight, weight 30, no sex) and send no API calls. A valid CTA sends POST quick-estimate {182,75,male} -> 200, then POST product/analyze -> 200. The H&M link showed calcola-fallback; the pasted size chart then gave calcola-result 'L' with an LLM reason, no crash. /wardrobe: tape-calibration is closed by default, the toggle opens 4 prefilled fields, save shows the 'Misure verificate' toast, and the values persist after reload (101/85.5/99/47). The dashboard estimate then kept those tape values (the LLM reason cited 101/85.5). Public '/': #000 background, hero-logo /logo-white.png 576px wide and exactly centered, white slogan/main text, white CTA with black text, brand-logo in the header, no grey box, favicon links present. The app header is #000 with the white logo; nav is white when active and #A3A3A3 otherwise. Profile auto-measure, Studio and Settings load.

minor.issue: When kept_precise is true, weight_kg is updated but brand_sizes/precision stay from the tape/photo run. This is acceptable by design, but a weight change of e.g. 20kg is silently ignored for the circumferences. Consider re-estimating when the weight differs by more than ~5kg.
The frontend swallows quick-estimate errors (persistMeasurements returns false and analyze continues), so if it fails the brand comparison runs on stale measurements with no feedback.

ui_bugs.issue: 'AFFIDABILE: SÌ' badge: the .label-caps colour (rgb 82,82,82) overrides text-white on bg-emerald-700, so it is nearly unreadable. Same root cause as the iteration_9 CTA bug. Use !text-white.

ui_bugs.component: Language switcher in the black header
ui_bugs.issue: The trigger has bg-white with text colour #A3A3A3 (theme-dark --vfit-muted applied through .label-caps), so the 'IT' label is grey on white with low contrast. It also looks like a white box on the black bar. Make it transparent with white text, or keep it white with black text.

issues: Nav labels wrap onto two lines ('PROVA|TAGLIA', 'ANALISI|PRODOTTO', 'IL TUO|ARMADIO' are 50px tall vs 33px for the others). Add whitespace-nowrap or reduce the tracking/gap.
On one initial load of /profile the header briefly rendered without the shell-brand logo and with a different layout, which settled after a few seconds. Possibly a loading-state header; check it.
The logo PNG has a grey gradient fill, so it reads as light grey rather than pure white on #000. This is fine if intended.

action_items: Fix the contrast on [data-testid=accuracy-reliable]: .label-caps overrides text-white, so use !text-white
Fix the lang-switcher-trigger contrast in the dark header (grey text on a white box)
Prevent the header nav labels from wrapping (whitespace-nowrap)
Before redeploying, run the production build so the new index.html favicon links are included. The dev server needed a frontend restart before it served them.
Optional: show a toast or retry if quick-estimate fails, instead of silently continuing
critical_code_review_comments: The .label-caps global colour keeps overriding Tailwind text-* utilities (3rd occurrence). Fix it at the root: put .label-caps in @layer components, or remove its colour.
CalcolaTagliaBox number inputs: onChange casts to Number. Fine, but typing '1' briefly passes no validation until the value is complete. OK.
server.py is now 1884 lines; split the measurements/estimate routes into a router

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 functional; 1 stale index.html check fixed by a frontend restart)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows pass; 2 contrast issues, 1 nav-wrap issue)

test_credentials: fam_test_1791784817 used read-only. The temporary users TEST_qe_* and TEST_ui_qe were created in Mongo and deleted afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest tests/test_quick_estimate.py (it creates and cleans its own temp user via mongosh). For toast checks use page.locator('[data-sonner-toast]', has_text=...) and never remove toast DOM nodes manually (that crashes React with an insertBefore error). The H&M productpage.1234 URL always gives the fallback; paste a chart text to reach calcola-result.
rca of the issue: Contrast: .label-caps in index.css sets color: var(--vfit-muted) outside the Tailwind layers, so it beats text-white. In .theme-dark --vfit-muted is #A3A3A3, which gives the grey-on-white lang switcher. Favicon links missing in the served HTML: the CRA dev server caches public/index.html, so a restart was needed.
